title: Reshuffled Registration
description: Chaos doesn't stop at the login page — the register form deserves the same locator-resilience workout. Combine several Practice mode toggles at once and prove a full registration still completes cleanly.
successCondition: With Practice mode's "Dynamic ids", "Slow network", and "Layout shift" toggles all switched on together, a test completes a full registration on /register — filling email, password, and selecting a role by label/name rather than hardcoded id, submitting, and confirming the resulting session lands on the dashboard — and the same script re-run after toggling all three off and back on still passes (ids differ between runs, an extra ~1.5-3.5s latency is tolerated, and a layout-shifting banner doesn't cause a mis-click).
hints: Combine presets instead of hand-picking: the Practice mode drawer's "Intermediate" preset is close, but this challenge specifically wants dynamicIds + slowNetwork + layoutShift together, so toggle them individually.
Prefer role/label-based locators throughout, and give the submit action a generous timeout rather than a fixed short wait — three chaos toggles are stacked here.
